name: tracker-card
description: Shipment waybill card with live status, copyable tracking number, origin-to-destination route, checkpoint timeline, and a pickup scan mark.
purpose: Gives an ecommerce or logistics landing a trusted in-transit moment shoppers can read, copy, and act on without opening an account dashboard.
bestFor: campaign pages that preview a live parcel
avoidFor: carrier operations dashboards with hundreds of shipments
checkout that still needs a payment form
event tickets that need a real barcode scanner

files.content:
